title: Swap: Hamburger button (daisyUI)
notes:
Swap allows you to toggle the visibility of two elements using a checkbox or a class name.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/swap/+page.md
code:
<label class="btn btn-circle swap swap-rotate">
  <!-- this hidden checkbox controls the state -->
  <input type="checkbox" />

  <!-- hamburger icon -->
  <svg
    class="swap-off fill-current"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="32"
    height="32"
    viewBox="0 0 512 512">
    <path d="M64,384H448V341.33H64Zm0-106.67H448V234.67H64ZM64,128v42.67H448V128Z" />
  </svg>

  <!-- close icon -->
  <svg
    class="swap-on fill-current"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="32"
    height="32"
    viewBox="0 0 512 512">
    <polygon
      points="400 145.49 366.51 112 256 222.51 145.49 112 112 145.49 222.51 256 112 366.51 145.49 400 256 289.49 366.51 400 400 366.51 289.49 256 400 145.49" />
  </svg>
</label>
